title: Matched d1 interpretation on protected development scopes
question: Does a versioned d1 lowering improve exact source interpretation on the same protected cases while preserving the supported incumbent controls?
method: Freeze five independently reviewed source opportunities in two same-release V2 reference sets. Grade actual CUDA d1 version 1 and 2 runs with the same admitted source, declared questions, focal contributions and alternatives. Compare the immutable evaluations by protected case.
commands: uv run ci eval run --run 429 --set-id 36 --comparison-arm baseline --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
uv run ci eval run --run 429 --set-id 37 --comparison-arm baseline --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
uv run ci eval run --run 431 --set-id 36 --comparison-arm revised --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
uv run ci eval run --run 431 --set-id 37 --comparison-arm revised --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
uv run ci eval operation-compare --baseline 38 --revised 40 --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
uv run ci eval operation-compare --baseline 39 --revised 41 --project nce-grinstead-snell-full-book --json
uv run ci contributions list --run 431 --method extract.pm2_d1 --include-details --include-interpretation --limit 60 --page-bytes 4000000 --json

agents.separation: Exact source only before the new paired predictions.
Separate source-only reading; prior development exposure disclosed.
Exact source and retained A/B rationale; no new prediction outputs.

inputs.role: Frozen facet, controls and comparison limits
Independent source-only A/B and adjudication notes
Exact baseline source and candidate inputs
Exact revised source and candidate inputs

outputs.role: Native source-only A/B/C protected pass receipts
Immutable matched literal and function results
Private scoped Reader meanings and exact normalization

conclusion: Exact authenticated probability normalization improved and the definition control survived. Roulette magnitude, condition host and local referent remain unsupported. The scoped improvement does not qualify broader interpretation adoption.
